ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 45% low-intensity black pixels concentrated centrally and along the trailing edge margins, versus 55% high-intensity white pixels across the lateral lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized dark 'butterfly' pigmentation field extending from the peduncle to the lobe midpoints. Right lobe features a distinctive cluster of dark, overlapping linear marks near the distal margin. Left lobe features sparse, thin dark vertical striations on a predominantly white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees at the vertex; symmetrical depth relative to the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular serrations (large notches) from the midpoint to the tip. Right lobe trailing edge displays more uniform, low-amplitude micro-serrations along a dark border.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve sweeping upwards and outwards; fluke tips are sharply tapered and predominantly dark-pigmented.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity white pixel clusters (0.5% to 1.5% of fluke height) detected on the dark central pigmentation field near the peduncle base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly distinct dark-pigmented rake marks on the white field of the right lobe. Sparse, unaligned diagonal dark scratches near the lateral margin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and indentation along the trailing edge of the left lobe. A localized area of light-colored (pinkish-white) pixels at the ventral insertion point of the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe contains a unique, high-contrast dark pigmentation cluster resembling a 'spinnaker' sail or complex geometric scribble.
